title: Integrate reusable assignments across batch workflows
description: Wire reusableTasks through batch export selection, JSON/CSV export construction, import decoding, flat-file batch validation, optimistic stale checks, no-op detection, transaction journaling, rollback, and response views. Resolve all names/UUIDs against one catalog snapshot under the store lock, canonicalize to stable UUIDs, validate every row before publication, and preserve all-or-nothing behavior when any definition is unknown, duplicated, concurrently deleted, or otherwise invalid. Ensure grouping/status/task selectors and complete dependency-graph resolution remain unchanged. Add integration and injected-failure tests for mixed task-field edits, preserve/replace/clear, definition rename between export and import, deletion between export and import, stale task timestamps, multiple rows, rollback, recovery, and JSON/human CLI results.

comments.message: Started integration work: auditing batch export/import and flat-file transaction paths for reusable task assignments.
